definitions.explanation: A light, hazy mist that appears in the evening as temperatures drop, creating a soft atmospheric effect.

examples.japanese: {夕靄|ゆうもや}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{包|つつ}んだ→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧。
examples.english: The evening haze enveloped the town.

examples.japanese: {夕靄|ゆうもや}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{向|む}こう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: The mountains were visible beyond the evening haze.

examples.japanese: ⟦{川沿|かわぞ}い→川沿い：03046_kawazoi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{夕靄|ゆうもや}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{立|た}ちこめ、⟦{対岸|たいがん}→対岸：17100_taigan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ぼんやり→ぼんやり：03727_bonyari⟧⟦{霞|かす}んで→霞む：14680_kasumu⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: Evening mist hung along the river, making the opposite bank appear faintly blurred.

notes:
A compound of {夕|ゆう} (evening) and ⟦{靄|もや}→靄：06506_moya⟧ (haze/mist). A literary and atmospheric word used primarily in descriptive writing, poetry, and scenic descriptions. ⟦{靄|もや}→靄：06506_moya⟧ is lighter and thinner than ⟦{霧|きり}→霧：02200_kiri⟧ (fog), so {夕靄|ゆうもや} suggests a gentler, more translucent effect than dense fog.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {夕靄|ゆうもや}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: evening haze rises
- {夕靄|ゆうもや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{包|つつ}まれる→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧: to be wrapped in evening haze
- {夕靄|ゆうもや}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧: evening haze settles
- {夕靄|ゆうもや}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧: in the evening haze

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{朝靄|あさもや}→朝靄：07866_asamoya⟧: morning haze — the morning counterpart
- {夕霧|ゆうぎり}: evening fog — denser and thicker than haze
- ⟦{靄|もや}→靄：06506_moya⟧: haze/mist — the general term for light mist
- ⟦{霞|かすみ}→霞：05042_kasumi⟧: haze — often used poetically, especially in spring
